title: Grounded Generation and Streamlit

learning_objectives: Explain prompt context, optional rewriting, and chat flow in plain language and connect it to src/rag_chain.py; src/prompt.py; app/app.py.
Trace one input through the grounded generation and streamlit stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: prompt context, optional rewriting, and chat flow
practical_outcomes: Trace the grounded generation and streamlit stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for prompt context, optional rewriting, and chat flow.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
